annual_probability.cite: mc-inputs.json analogues.event_weeks (earnings_release tag): of 19 quarterly earnings weeks from Q3 2021 to Q2 2026, 4 (Q1'22 -12.1%, Q2'22 -11.9%, Q3'24 -16.0%, Q2'25 +13.0%) moved >=10% in the earnings week; Poisson rate ~4 such quarters / 4.75y = 0.84/yr implies an annual probability of at least one such move of 1-e^-0.84 ~ 0.6.

impact.cite: mc-inputs.json analogues.largest_falls / event_weeks: week 2024-10-21 (Q3 2024 earnings_release), move -0.1597 -- the largest single weekly fall in the 5y history.

jumps.name: Gold price shock (real-yield / dollar driven correction)
jumps.reason: NEM sells gold at spot with no differentiated pricing, so a sudden rise in real yields or the dollar can move the stock sharply outside of earnings weeks; this risk is not captured by the SPY/IEF factor model (US market proxy set has no gold factor) and is distinct from the gradual de-rate already built into the bear scenario's target.
jumps.cite: research/NEM/2026-10-07-macro.md dominant_chain ('real yields (DFII10) + trade-weighted dollar (DTWEXBGS) -> gold price -> NEM revenue and margin -> EV/Sales and P/B multiple') and macro_bear; research/NEM/2026-10-07.md Business section ('revenue tracks metal prices... rather than any differentiated product pricing').

annual_probability.cite: mc-inputs.json analogues.largest_falls vs event_weeks: of the 10 largest weekly falls over the ~5y history (2021-10-18 to 2026-09-28), 5 do not coincide with any tagged earnings/filing event (2026-03-16, 2022-05-09, 2026-03-02, 2026-04-27, 2026-01-26) -- about 1 non-earnings shock-sized fall per year.
